shadowSentences: I love reading books in my free time.
He enjoys cooking new recipes on weekends.
She often goes for a walk in the park.
They like to watch movies together at home.
We always have family dinners every Sunday.
My friends and I play soccer every Saturday morning.
I prefer to listen to music while studying.
He started learning guitar during the pandemic last year.
She has visited several countries in Europe recently.
They plan to volunteer at the local shelter next month.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about travel experiences.
questions: Q1: Can you share a memorable travel experience you had?
Q2: What challenges did you face during that trip?
Q3: What do you think is the importance of traveling?
Q4: What advice would you give someone planning their first trip?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about study methods.
questions: Q1: What study methods do you find most effective?
Q2: Have you ever struggled with a particular subject while studying?
Q3: In your opinion, how important is it to have a structured study plan?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to students looking to improve their study habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly habits.
questions: Q1: Can you describe some eco-friendly habits you follow?
Q2: What difficulties have you encountered in maintaining these habits?
Q3: What role do you think individuals play in protecting the environment?
Q4: What suggestions would you offer for someone wanting to adopt greener habits?
